name: renium
description: Roblox Studio sync for VS Code/Cursor using native executables

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Renium executes workspace binaries and synchronizes workspace files, so the workspace must be trusted.

colors.description: Foreground color for Renium package script preview tabs.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No link packages yet.
Pack any instance into a reusable read-only package: right-click it in the Renium Explorer and choose Create Link.
[Open Explorer](command:renium.openExplorer)

renium.exportCliPath.description: Path to the Renium executable used for Studio export and sync.

renium.rustCliPath.description: Path to the Renium CLI. Renium also searches bin/ and source-repository build folders.

renium.snapshotDir.description: Snapshot directory (relative to projectRoot unless absolute)

renium.transport.description: Transport mode used by the export CLI.

renium.configTomlPath.description: Path to config.toml that defines the Roblox MCP server

renium.instanceWorkers.description: 0 = auto; otherwise manual instance batch worker count

renium.importWorkers.description: 0 = auto; otherwise manual direct-import worker count

renium.chunkSize.description: Chunk size used for exporter RPC payload paging. Default is 4 MiB to reduce round trips on large service exports; maximum is 8 MiB.

renium.snapshotInstanceChunkSize.description: Instance count per snapshot chunk file (0 disables chunk splitting).

renium.bridgeWaitSeconds.description: Max wait for plugin bridge channels to connect.

renium.bridgePorts.description: Comma-separated WebSocket bridge ports used by plugin and exporter. Only three ports are supported by default.

renium.usePersistentBridge.description: Keep a persistent Rust bridge daemon alive for WebSocket exports so repeated full syncs reuse already-open Roblox Studio bridge channels instead of reconnecting every run.

renium.verifyEditorPushSources.description: Verify pushed Lua source by reading it back from Studio after editor -> Studio sync. Slower; useful for debugging sync mismatches.

renium.adaptiveThrottle.description: Adaptive Studio FPS throttle for export RPCs.

renium.noUpdateEditorIcons.description: Skip editor icon settings updates during export.

renium.autoSyncOnSave.description: Automatically sync changed service(s) after file save

renium.autoSyncDebounceMs.description: Debounce time before triggering auto sync

renium.editorLiveSyncEnabled.description: Enable live sync. When false, src changes do not push to Studio and Studio changes do not import into src.

renium.editorLiveSyncOnStartup.description: Legacy compatibility setting. Live sync startup is controlled by renium.editorLiveSyncEnabled.

renium.studioLiveSyncEnabled.description: When editor live sync is on, import dirty Studio services back into src.

renium.studioLiveSyncPollMs.description: Base Studio dirty-state poll interval for live sync. Polling backs off while idle or after errors.

enumDescriptions: Start from Studio and import its state into src before watching for later edits.
Start from src and push it to Studio before watching for later edits.
Start watching without an initial import or push.
renium.liveSync.initialSyncPriority.description: Which side initializes a newly started live-sync session.

renium.liveSync.changesThreshold.description: Maximum Studio change records Renium applies through the granular fast path. Larger batches use the protected full-import path.

renium.liveSync.diffLinesLimit.description: Maximum lines rendered per side in a live-sync conflict preview. Full local and Studio backup files are preserved without truncation.

enumDescriptions: Show every manual live-sync conflict prompt.
Show only the first manual live-sync conflict prompt in each session.
Keep backups and log manual conflicts without showing a prompt.
renium.liveSync.displayPrompts.description: When Renium should interrupt you for manual live-sync conflict review.

renium.liveSync.overridePackages.description: Allow editor pushes to write read-only Renium link-package mirrors. Disabled by default to preserve package protection.

renium.logLevel.description: Minimum Renium output level to show in the Output panel. Errors still surface in VS Code notifications.

enumDescriptions: No side prioritized: keep your local version on disk and pop a notification with a side-by-side diff so you can review or switch to Studio's. The file always stays valid (no conflict markers are written).
Filesystem wins: your editor's version of the overlapping lines is kept automatically.
Studio wins: Studio's version of the overlapping lines is kept automatically.
renium.liveSync.conflictResolution.description: How to resolve overlapping concurrent edits to the same script during live sync, when the same lines changed in both Studio and your editor. Non-overlapping concurrent edits are always merged automatically. Conflict markers are never written into your scripts; both sides are always backed up under .renium/conflicts. The Studio plugin's setting, when chosen there, overrides this.

renium.runImport.description: Run import stage so src and generated project JSON are updated

renium.importMode.description: Import mode for the export CLI.

renium.performanceMode.description: Export scheduling mode. Throughput favors wall time, balanced limits visible stalls, smooth prioritizes Studio responsiveness over speed.

renium.modifiedDefaultBypass.description: Compact-v5 fast path that adaptively uses IsPropertyModified to avoid reading defaulted properties after guarded validation. Disabled by default.

renium.watchConfigPath.description: Reserved config path for future live-sync support.

renium.wsWaitSeconds.description: Studio connection wait timeout in seconds

renium.progressHeartbeatSeconds.description: Heartbeat interval for long-running command progress logs.

renium.benchmarkRuns.description: Number of repeated full-sync iterations to run for benchmark mode.

renium.wallySync.wallyPath.description: Wally executable used by Sync Wally Packages.

renium.wallySync.rojoPath.description: Deprecated: Rojo is no longer required. Renium imports Wally packages directly.

renium.wallySync.packagesDir.description: Wally packages directory, relative to projectRoot unless absolute.

renium.wallySync.targetService.description: Service that receives the generated Wally Packages folder.

renium.wallySync.targetName.description: Folder name used for imported Wally packages under the target service.

renium.wallySync.runInstall.description: Run wally install before building and importing Packages.

renium.wallySync.realms.description: Comma list of Wally realms to import. 'server' imports ServerPackages into ServerStorage; 'dev' imports DevPackages. Realms are skipped when their package directory is absent.

renium.wallySync.applyToStudio.description: After syncing Wally packages into src, optionally apply the package tree to Studio.

renium.link.manifest.description: Path to the renium-link manifest, relative to projectRoot unless absolute.

renium.link.folder.description: Where new packages are saved. Empty (default) uses the per-user global library at Documents/Renium/Packages so packages are usable from any project. Set a project-relative path like 'links' to store (and commit) packages inside this project instead.

renium.link.cacheDir.description: Folder where cloned git/Wally link sources are cached, relative to projectRoot unless absolute. Blank uses .renium/link-cache. Overrides the manifest cacheDir.

renium.link.gitPath.description: Git executable used to fetch git link sources (public and private).

renium.link.offline.description: Never fetch git/Wally link sources; use only what is already cached.

renium.link.autoApplyOnManifestChange.description: Re-apply links automatically when renium-link.json changes. Link packages can contain Luau source; disabled by default.

renium.link.applyToStudio.description: After materializing link targets into src, optionally push them to Studio. Link packages can contain Luau source.

renium.gitSync.gitPath.description: Git executable used by the Renium Git tab.

renium.gitSync.remote.description: Default Git remote used by Renium Git sync commands.

renium.gitSync.branch.description: Optional branch override for Renium Git sync. Blank uses the current checked out branch.

renium.gitSync.autoFetch.description: Fetch the configured remote before pull or push workflows.

renium.gitSync.runFullSyncBeforePush.description: Whether Renium should run a Full Sync before Git commit/push workflows.

renium.gitSync.stageMode.description: How Renium stages files for Git commit/push. Default behavior is tracked src/ changes only; 'configuredPaths' restricts staging to stagePaths.

renium.gitSync.stagePaths.description: Pathspec list used when gitSync.stageMode is configuredPaths. Defaults to src only, which is the canonical Renium game code/data folder.

renium.gitSync.includeUntracked.description: Allow Git commit/push to include untracked files. Disabled by default for safety.

renium.gitSync.commitMessageTemplate.description: Default commit message template for Git commit/push. Supports ${date}, ${datetime}, and ${branch}.

renium.gitSync.confirmBeforePush.description: Require a confirmation dialog before Renium commits or pushes Git changes.

renium.gitSync.requireCleanWorktreeBefor.description: Block Git pull while the repository has local worktree changes.

renium.gitSync.applyPulledChangesToStudi.description: After a successful Git pull, optionally apply pulled src changes back into Studio using Renium editor->Studio sync.

renium.gitSync.timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for git commands started from the Git tab.

renium.gitSync.outputBehavior.description: Controls when the Renium output channel is shown for Git sync commands.

scripts.test: npm run test:compile && node --test out-test/test/gitSync.test.js out-test/test/conflictMerge.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run compile && npm run test
scripts.package: npm run compile && npx --no-install vsce package -o renium.vsix
